scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run contrast && bun run docs-links && bun run test && bun run test:api
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "bun run --filter @asmbots/web dev" "bun run dev:worker"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @asmbots/web build && bun run --filter @asmbots/api build
scripts.deploy: echo 'bun run deploy: not wired until EXEC 3.4 (deploy playbook)' >&2 && exit 1
